title: Russian Ballistic Missile Barrage Sets Kyiv Warehouse Ablaze, Kills One
detail: Ukraine's Air Force warned of a ballistic missile threat from the northeast shortly before 22:00 on August 21, and explosions rocked Kyiv around 01:00 local time on August 22, minutes after an air raid alert. A warehouse caught fire in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district; one person was killed and others injured, according to preliminary reports. It followed the massive Russian barrage that killed 15 in Kyiv two days earlier on August 20.

title: Russian Drone Strikes Minibus and Hits Zaporizhzhia Region, Killing 4, Wounding 15
detail: A Russian drone struck a route minibus in Zaporizhzhia city, wounding three passengers, regional military administration head Ivan Fedorov said. Across the wider Zaporizhzhia region, Russian drone strikes on August 22 killed four people and wounded another 15, local officials reported, as part of a broader wave of Russian and Ukrainian cross-border attacks the day after the deadly Kryvyi Rih shopping mall strike.

media.caption: Report on a Russian drone strike on a minibus in Zaporizhzhia, August 22, 2026

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Ozon Logistics Hub and Novokuybyshevsk Refinery in Russia's Samara Oblast
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Ozon marketplace logistics complex in Chapaevsk, Samara Oblast, for the first time overnight on August 21-22, sparking a major fire that had engulfed most of the 135,000-square-meter facility by 07:30 and forcing evacuation of more than 500 workers. Drones also struck the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery in the same region. Russian authorities reported at least six people killed overnight in the wider wave of Ukrainian strikes. Ukraine has increasingly targeted Russian refineries, fuel depots, and logistics infrastructure to disrupt revenue and supply chains sustaining the war.

media.caption: Fire at the Ozon logistics hub in Chapaevsk, Samara Oblast, after a Ukrainian drone strike, August 22, 2026
